papers.paper: 1st Semester Examination 2022/2023 Session (CSC 412: Microprocessor Interfacing). Answer any three questions; 2 hours; 7 December 2023
papers.source: CSC 412(2022_2023).pdf (scanned, read from the page images; handwritten notes on the scan are not copied)

questions.text: (a) Write instructions to load the two hexadecimal numbers 32H and 48H in registers A and B, respectively. Add the numbers and display the sum at the LED output port PORT. (5 marks)
(b) What are the various interrupts in 8085 microprocessor? Which is the highest priority interrupt? State two reasons why Interrupt is significant in any microprocessor? (8 marks)
(c) What type of architecture is used in 8088 microprocessor? What is the function of accumulator in an 8088 microprocessor? Is 8088 a CISC or RISC? (3 marks)

(d)(i) What is the length of stack pointer in 8085 microprocessor? And what is its use? (2 marks)
(ii) What are the two machine control operations used in 8085 microprocessor? (2 marks)
(a) If the 8085 adds 87H and 79H, specify the contents of the accumulator and the status of the S, Z, and CY flag. (7 marks)
(b) What is meant by DMA operation? What are the modes of operation of DMA? (4 marks)
(c) Explain the function of ALU and IO/M signals in the 8085 architecture. (3 marks)

(d) (i) How many memory locations can be addressed by a microprocessor with 14 address lines? (2 marks)
(ii) Specify the number of registers and memory cells required in a 128 x 4 memory chip? (2 marks)
(iii) Define two-byte instruction with one example. (2 marks)
(a) Describe the trade-offs between using a microcontroller and a microprocessor in an embedded system design. When would you prefer one over the other? (4 marks)

(b) Identify five different addressing schemes of 8086 microprocessor. Illustrate any two of them. (7 marks)
(c) Explain the concept of pipelining in 8086. Discuss two advantages and one disadvantage. (4 marks)
(d) What is the difference between minimum and maximum modes of 8086? How are these modes selected? (3 marks)
(e) Explain the memory segmentation in the 8086 microprocessor and its significance. (2 marks)

(a) (i) Describe the various memory types used in embedded systems and their purposes.
(ii) Explain how embedded system is different from processors. (6 marks)

(b) Give the two major register classifications of 8086 and highlight four of its segment registers. (6 marks)
(c) List the two functional parts of 8086 microprocessors. (2 marks)

(d) Draw the format of 8085 flag register. (4 marks)
(e) Specify the function of the address bus and the direction of the information flow on the address bus. (2 marks)
(a) Compare and contrast Harvard and Von Neumann architectures in the context of microcontrollers. Discuss their implications on embedded system design. (8 marks)
(b) How are the instructions of 8085 classified based on their (i) function and (ii) word length? Give an example each. (7 marks)
(c) What are the control signals used for DMA operation? (3 marks)

(d) (i) What determines whether a Microprocessor is an 8, 16 or 32 bit?
(ii) Why is the data bus bidirectional? (2 marks)
